fix.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding forest diversion and the Forest Rights Act?
o: MoEF's 2009 circular required completion of FRA processes before forest diversion under the FCA
Under the 2009 circular, forest diversion could go ahead before FRA claims were settled if the project was of public importance
Gram Sabha consent is relevant to the FRA process
Niyamgiri saw Gram Sabha rejection of bauxite mining
fix.x: MoEF's August 2009 circular barred forest diversion under the FCA until FRA processes, including Gram Sabha consent, were complete; it made no public-importance exception. In Niyamgiri (2013) the Gram Sabhas rejected bauxite mining. The Forest Conservation Rules, 2022 later diluted this sequencing.
